name: smsgecko
description: SMSGecko — virtual phone numbers for OTP & verification (full-stack)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @smsgecko/shared && npm run build -w @smsgecko/api && npm run build -w @smsgecko/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @smsgecko/web && npm run lint -w @smsgecko/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smsgecko/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smsgecko/api && npm run typecheck -w @smsgecko/web
